name: GitHub issue webhook → Slack
description: Receives a GitHub issue webhook (configure the repo's webhook URL to the daemon's /trigger endpoint with the per-flow secret), formats the payload into a Slack-friendly line, and posts to your channel. Use case: route new issues from a busy repo into a triage channel.

compute.line: '[' + row.repository.full_name + '] #' + string(row.issue.number) + ' ' + row.action + ' by ' + row.sender.login + ': ' + row.issue.title
